page-title.purpose: One per screen; the screen's name.

lede.purpose: What this screen shows and does.

caption.purpose: Hints, status lines and secondary facts.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: The single separation shadow under panels.

shadows.name: panel-dark
shadows.purpose: The same separation in dark appearance.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The committing action, once per panel.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent, #3550c8); color: var(--accent-ink, #fff); padding: 10px 24px; font: 600 15px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #3550c8); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: progress; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: A supporting action inside a panel or toolbar.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { border: 1px solid var(--accent, #3550c8); color: var(--accent, #3550c8); background: transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 5px 14px; font: 600 14px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--accent-soft, #e3e8fb); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #3550c8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: Label above the field; the value stays on error.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; font: 400 14px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-2, #4a5061); } .ds-field input { font: inherit; font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink, #1a1d26); background: var(--ground, #f3f4f7); border: 1px solid var(--line, #dcdfe7); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #3550c8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The only grouping surface; one level deep.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: var(--panel, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #dcdfe7); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,24,40,.06), 0 4px 14px rgba(20,24,40,.05); padding: 18px; color: var(--ink, #1a1d26); font: 400 15px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-2, #4a5061); }

components.name: Sidebar row
components.description: Navigation rows with an 18 px line icon and label; selected uses the indigo wash.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 3px; width: 248px; padding: 8px; background: var(--side, #e9ebf1); border-radius: 8px; font: 13px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #4a5061); padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 8px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background: var(--panel, #fff); color: var(--ink, #1a1d26); } .ds-nav-row--on { background: var(--accent-soft, #e3e8fb); color: var(--accent, #3550c8); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #3550c8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Version pill
components.description: App name and version inline; opens What's New.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 26px; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dcdfe7); background: var(--panel, #fff); color: var(--ink, #1a1d26); font: 600 11px/1 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pill span { font-weight: 400; font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted, #737a8c); } .ds-pill:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #3550c8); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #3550c8); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Library is a room full of instruments that are already working: downloads, imports, a library on the NAS, companion apps on the network. The interface's job is to make that room legible without raising its voice. Pages are calm and scannable, state is stated in plain words, and the accent appears only where the owner can act or where something is selected. Nothing decorates; everything reports. The system is deliberately small and browser-native, sharing the KH family shell while keeping its own tokens; controls are softly rounded with quiet borders and responsive hover and focus states.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (indigo) for primary action, selection and state only.
Light and dark are both first-class; the saved appearance choice wins over the OS.
Plain-language state everywhere; a failure says what was not done and how to recover.
Tables and panels, not cards inside cards.
Native browser affordances kept: focus ring, selection, tabular numerals, scrollbars.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent marks action, selection and current location. It is never used to decorate a heading, an icon set, or a background.

rules.name: The State Is Type Rule
rules.body: A state change is written in words at body or caption size; it never relies on color alone, and it never becomes a badge unless it is a short, stable label.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: One primary reading column; no split panes, no side-by-side settings columns except paired fields of the same kind.

rules.name: The One Level Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are one level deep. A panel inside a panel is a grouping problem, not a styling problem.

rules.name: The Soft Corner Rule
rules.body: Rounded, never pill-shaped, except for the version pill, filter chips and status dots.

dos: Keep one accent for action, selection and state, and let borders and surfaces do the rest.
Write states in plain words at caption size, with the recovery step when something failed.
Use tabular numerals in tables, progress and counts.
Keep the saved appearance choice authoritative in both themes and check contrast in each.
Keep controls softly rounded (8 px) with quiet hairline borders and responsive hover/focus states.
donts: Don't nest panels or use cards inside cards.
Don't use accent color for decoration, headings or icon sets.
Don't use color alone for connection, warning or failure states.
Don't add a component framework or design language; extend these tokens and components.
Don't use eyebrow labels above headings, gradient text, glass/blur decoration, or emoji as icons.
Don't rely on hover-only affordances where touch users need the same action.
